via.description: Identifier of the third-party client that wrote this record (e.g. 'tech.tokimeki'). Set only by clients other than mochott itself; mochott indexes such records, and their updates, from the firehose. Whoever rewrites the record keeps this field.

path.description: Custom URL path slug for the article. Used to construct human-readable URLs.

slug.description: Author-chosen URL slug (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens), unique among the author's articles. Managed by mochott; third-party clients should not set it.

blobs.description: Blob references for media embedded within the article content.

topic.description: Slug of the platform writing topic (投稿のお題) this article participates in.

labels.description: Self-label values (content warnings) for this article.

content.description: Rich text content in TipTap editor JSON format.

profile.description: AT URI of the publication profile this article belongs to.

createdAt.description: Publication timestamp of the article. Authors may set it to a past date (e.g. when migrating content); it is never later than the record write time.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the article was last updated.

coverImage.description: Cover image displayed at the top of the article and in previews.

description.description: Short summary or excerpt of the article, used for previews and SEO.

textContent.description: Plain text representation of the article content, primarily for search indexing and text-only consumers.

minisiteCategory.description: Category of the article within a minisite. Only meaningful while the article belongs to that minisite and the minisite still defines the slug.

main.description: Record representing a single blog article published to a publication.

marks.description: Inline formatting marks applied to this node.

content.description: Child nodes of this document node.

tiptapDocument.description: A TipTap editor document node. Represents a recursive tree structure for rich text content.

slug.description: Slug of a category in that minisite's categories.

minisite.description: AT URI of the site.mochott.minisite record that defines the category.

minisiteCategory.description: A reference to a category defined in a site.mochott.minisite record.

description: A blog article record. Contains rich text content, metadata, and optional media attachments.
